name: Esens (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Esens (a black bear on a red wall on white).
history: Municipal flag of Esens; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Esens arms — bear on a wall
